headline: A calmer path
intro: Dedicated payroll support for the work before the numbers are final. Bring order to timesheets, employee changes, questions, and provider handoffs while your payroll owner keeps approval.
serviceIntro: Build support around the pay cycle you actually run. Choose a focused workflow, give it clear inputs, and keep exceptions visible before the cutoff.
story: Late timesheets and unclear approvals create a scramble that software alone cannot solve. A dedicated assistant keeps requests moving, records current, and the next review ready.
footer: Dedicated payroll administration support for organized inputs, timely follow-up, and dependable provider handoffs.
contact: Let’s take the rush out of payroll.
prepare: Your pay calendar and current bottleneck
The systems and provider you work with
The reviewer responsible for final approval
pillars: Track missing hours, changes, and approvals against the actual pay calendar.
Prepare source-linked records, exception notes, and a clear status for your reviewer.
Pay, bank, tax, and release decisions stay with your authorized payroll team.

services.title: Payroll operations support
services.description: Filipino payroll operations help for timesheet chasing, employee-change logs, pay-period checklists, and payroll-provider handoffs.
services.alt: Two women working on financial documents and calculations in an office.
audience: Payroll managers, finance teams, and business owners who need dependable preparation before final review.
services.problem: Your payroll provider can calculate checks, but your team still has to collect hours, chase approvals, log changes, and catch missing details before cut-off.
inputs: The current pay calendar, source records, and approved checklist
Named system access and a reviewer for questions
Examples of accepted work and escalation rules
work: collect timesheets, PTO notes, bonus requests, and manager approvals before each payroll run
keep a pay-period tracker with missing items, due dates, and owner names
prepare employee-change packets for new hires, terminations, address updates, and direct-deposit changes
send clean handoff notes to the payroll provider or internal payroll owner
outputs: A current payroll operations support tracker with source references
A dated exception list with owners and next actions
A prepared handoff for the authorized reviewer
controls: the Filipino payroll assistant prepares payroll data but does not approve pay, change bank details alone, or submit final payroll
payroll owners review a cut-off checklist before any file goes to the provider
sensitive employee files stay in approved systems with role-based access
boundaries: Pay, tax, benefits, bank changes, and payment release remain with your authorized payroll owner.
scenarios: Filipino payroll operations help for timesheet chasing, employee-change logs, pay-period checklists, and payroll-provider handoffs.
Start with one pay cycle. Review the work and unresolved items before extending the scope.
workflow: pick one payroll cycle and list every item that slows the team down
build a cut-off tracker with columns for employee, item, owner, status, and approval
run one complete pay cycle where the Filipino payroll assistant prepares the tracker and the payroll owner checks it each workday
keep only the tasks that reduce late edits or manager follow-up time

faqs.question: Can a Filipino payroll assistant run payroll?
faqs.answer: No. Treat the role as payroll prep and follow-up support. A payroll owner or provider should approve final pay, tax, benefits, and banking actions.

faqs.question: What should we hand off first?
faqs.answer: Start with timesheet chasing, missing approval lists, employee-change logs, and provider notes. These tasks are repeatable and easy to review.

faqs.question: How do we protect payroll data?
faqs.answer: Use limited accounts, named access, audit logs, and a rule that bank, pay-rate, tax, and termination changes need owner approval.

services.title: Payroll employee support
services.description: Payroll inbox and employee-support help for status replies, document requests, paystub routing, and issue triage.
services.alt: Accountant reviewing financial documents with a calculator
audience: Payroll managers, finance teams, and business owners who need dependable preparation before final review.
services.problem: Payroll questions pile up fast. Many are simple status or document requests, but a few need a payroll owner. The trick is sorting them safely.
inputs: The current pay calendar, source records, and approved checklist
Named system access and a reviewer for questions
Examples of accepted work and escalation rules
work: sort payroll inbox messages by paystub, PTO, tax form, direct deposit, benefits, or manager approval need
send approved replies for common questions about timing, documents, and next steps
log employee issues with date, person, topic, system link, and payroll-owner decision needed
route urgent or sensitive questions to the right owner without guessing
outputs: A current payroll employee support tracker with source references
A dated exception list with owners and next actions
A prepared handoff for the authorized reviewer
controls: assistants use approved reply templates and do not promise payroll outcomes
pay disputes, tax questions, garnishments, benefits, and bank changes go to the payroll owner
weekly QA checks compare replies against the approved answer bank
boundaries: Pay, tax, benefits, bank changes, and payment release remain with your authorized payroll owner.
scenarios: Payroll inbox and employee-support help for status replies, document requests, paystub routing, and issue triage.
Start with one pay cycle. Review the work and unresolved items before extending the scope.
workflow: pull a recent set of payroll questions and group them by topic
write safe reply templates for the questions that keep coming back
give the Filipino payroll assistant an escalation list for anything involving pay amount, taxes, legal notices, or bank details
review the inbox log twice a week until the reply quality is steady

faqs.question: Can a Filipino payroll assistant answer employee pay questions?
faqs.answer: They can send approved status replies and collect details. Pay amount, tax, garnishment, and policy answers should come from the payroll owner.

faqs.question: What inbox work is safe to outsource?
faqs.answer: Document routing, missing-detail requests, ticket tagging, follow-up reminders, and status updates are good first tasks.

faqs.question: How do we avoid bad answers?
faqs.answer: Use a short answer bank, require escalation for sensitive topics, and review a sample of replies each week.

services.title: Payroll admin support
services.description: Back-office payroll admin help for file naming, records cleanup, onboarding documents, and recurring HR/payroll reminders.
services.alt: Business professional using calculator and laptop while working at office desk.
audience: Payroll managers, finance teams, and business owners who need dependable preparation before final review.
services.problem: Payroll admin work is usually small, repeated, and easy to delay. When it slips, payroll day turns into a scramble.
inputs: The current pay calendar, source records, and approved checklist
Named system access and a reviewer for questions
Examples of accepted work and escalation rules
work: rename and file onboarding, tax, direct-deposit, and policy documents in the approved system
maintain payroll calendars with cut-off dates, reminders, and manager approval windows
prepare new-hire and termination checklists for payroll-owner review
reconcile employee lists across HR, scheduling, and payroll systems for missing records
outputs: A current payroll admin support tracker with source references
A dated exception list with owners and next actions
A prepared handoff for the authorized reviewer
controls: assistants organize and flag records but do not make pay-rate, tax, or employment-status decisions
the payroll owner approves final new-hire and termination packets
access starts with view or upload rights before any broader permissions are added
boundaries: Pay, tax, benefits, bank changes, and payment release remain with your authorized payroll owner.
scenarios: Back-office payroll admin help for file naming, records cleanup, onboarding documents, and recurring HR/payroll reminders.
Start with one pay cycle. Review the work and unresolved items before extending the scope.
workflow: choose one messy admin lane, such as new-hire packets or document filing
show three good examples and three bad examples so the Filipino payroll assistant can spot gaps
set a daily missing-record report during the first pay cycle
add more admin tasks only after the first lane stays clean through a full pay cycle

faqs.question: Is payroll admin a full payroll role?
faqs.answer: No. It is support work around files, checklists, reminders, and records. Keep final payroll decisions with the payroll owner.

faqs.question: What makes this work a good fit for Filipino talent?
faqs.answer: The work repeats each pay period, has clear examples, and can be checked with a simple list.

faqs.question: How much access should we give first?
faqs.answer: Start with the least access needed. Add permissions only after the Filipino payroll assistant shows they can follow the process.

services.title: Payroll reporting and QA support
services.description: Payroll reporting support for exception logs, missing-data checks, approval reports, and post-run cleanup.
services.alt: Person checking financial reports with a calculator and pen
audience: Payroll managers, finance teams, and business owners who need dependable preparation before final review.
services.problem: Small payroll errors often come from missing inputs, late approvals, and weak review notes. A clear QA log catches more of that before payroll closes.
inputs: The current pay calendar, source records, and approved checklist
Named system access and a reviewer for questions
Examples of accepted work and escalation rules
work: build exception reports for missing hours, duplicate entries, late approvals, and unusual changes
prepare a pre-payroll QA checklist for the payroll owner
track post-run issues by root cause, owner, and fix date
summarize weekly payroll admin trends for managers
outputs: A current payroll reporting and qa support tracker with source references
A dated exception list with owners and next actions
A prepared handoff for the authorized reviewer
controls: assistants flag exceptions but do not decide final pay corrections
every QA report links back to the source record or manager approval
sensitive reports use approved folders and named reviewers only
boundaries: Pay, tax, benefits, bank changes, and payment release remain with your authorized payroll owner.
scenarios: Payroll reporting support for exception logs, missing-data checks, approval reports, and post-run cleanup.
Start with one pay cycle. Review the work and unresolved items before extending the scope.
workflow: pick three payroll mistakes or delays you want to prevent
turn those into a one-page QA checklist with examples
have the Filipino payroll assistant prepare the report before cut-off while the owner reviews the exceptions
compare the first two cycles and remove checks that do not catch real problems

faqs.question: Can reporting support replace payroll review?
faqs.answer: No. It helps the payroll owner see issues sooner. The owner still approves pay changes and final payroll.

faqs.question: Which reports should we start with?
faqs.answer: Start with missing hours, late approvals, duplicate entries, and employee changes since the last run.

faqs.question: How do we know the Filipino payroll assistant is helping?
faqs.answer: Track fewer late edits, fewer manager chases, cleaner handoff notes, and faster payroll-owner review.
